name: core-pph-ppn-retrieval
description: Questions on the core PPh and PPN regulations (UU 36/2008, UU 42/2009, UU 7/2021, PP 55/2022, PP 20/2026, PP 58/2023, PMK 168/2023, PMK 131/2024). Expected articles were located by searching the extracted text for the provision (for example 'Tarif Pajak Pertambahan Nilai yaitu: a. sebesar 11%' in UU 7/2021 Pasal 7) and still need confirmation by a tax reviewer.
